The '''Destroyer-I ion engine''' was a large-scale model of [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]] that was manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. The [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] had three Destroyer-I ion engines, that served as main engine units, and four [[Gemon-4 ion engine/Legends|Gemon-4 ion engines]], for emergency or supplementary sublight drives.<ref name="EGVV" />
